turns.user: I have a monthly pass for job seekers. Can I get the airport bus add-on?
turns.agent:
No. The monthly pass for job seekers is excluded from the discounted 100E add-on. Under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, you’d need the full-price 100E airport shuttle ticket (2,500 HUF) for a 100E trip, unless you independently qualify for a documented free-travel entitlement. The add-on, when eligible, is for one 100E trip and does not cover connecting routes.

For 200E, the add-on is not used; ordinary ticket and pass rules apply. See BKK’s add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket and airport shuttle bus single ticket. Check those official pages for current information; I haven’t live-verified today’s fare.

turns.user: But it's a Budapest pass. Are you sure the add-on isn't valid?

Yes—the key detail is the specific pass type. The 5 November 2026 snapshot explicitly excludes the monthly pass for job seekers from the 100E add-on, even though it is a Budapest pass. So that pass alone does not qualify for the add-on; the snapshot lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF. This is separate from the general rule for other eligible Budapest passes, and I haven’t live-verified current policy.

See BKK’s add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket for the official rule, and airport shuttle bus single ticket for the full-price ticket. The pass doesn’t affect the 200E in the same way; ordinary ticket/pass rules apply there.
